issue.title: Enforce PR template, description CI check, CODEOWNERS, and required reviews
issue.body:
## Summary

Humans (and some AI-assisted flows) still open PRs with empty or CodeRabbit-only bodies — e.g. [#306](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/pull/306). Agent rules under `.cursor/` do not apply to the GitHub UI. Enforce the template and review requests at the platform layer.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Add `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md` matching `.cursor/templates/pr-template.md` so the GitHub UI pre-fills the body
- [ ] Add a PR Description CI workflow that fails when required sections are missing (`### TLDR`, `Refs #NNN`, `### How to verify`) or the body is CodeRabbit-only / empty placeholders
- [ ] Exempt Dependabot PRs from the full template check
- [ ] Add `.github/CODEOWNERS` so default reviewers are auto-requested
- [ ] Document the new check in `docs/ci.md` / `.github/README.md` and note branch-protection steps to make **PR Description** + reviews required on `main`
- [ ] After merge (or with admin rights): mark **PR Description** as a required status check and require at least one approving review (CODEOWNERS) on `main`

## Out of scope

- Softening the agent template sections
- Auto-filling PR bodies via a bot

## Verification

- Unit tests for the validation script
- Open a draft PR / edit body to confirm check fails then passes
- Confirm CODEOWNERS requests a review on a new PR

## Links

- Example empty body: https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/pull/306
- Related (docs-only, explicitly deferred gates): #173, #211
